# Kaushik Arunachalam — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Kaushik Arunachalam, a Computer Science student at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham (Chennai, India), focused on data analytics and software development.

This is a single-page site. All sections live on the same URL, addressable by anchor:

- [About](/#about) — background and current focus
- [Skills](/#skills) — languages, data & databases, data analytics, web development, soft skills
- [Projects](/#projects) — selected projects (in progress)
- [Experience](/#experience) — work history
- [Education](/#education) — degrees and schools
- [Certifications](/#certifications) — courses and credentials, grouped by skill area
- [Contact](/#contact) — email, GitHub, LinkedIn
